# reco_policies (Data Source)

Lists all threat detection policies. Data sources are intentionally limited to small, stable configuration objects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reco_policies" "all" {}

output "policy_names" {
  value = [for p in data.reco_policies.all.policies : p.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) List of threat detection policies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `all_alerts` (Number) Total alert count.
- `apps` (List of String) Associated applications.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Policy ID.
- `name` (String) Policy name.
- `open_alerts` (Number) Number of open alerts.
- `policy_type` (String) Policy type.
- `severity` (String) Severity level.
- `status` (String) Policy status (active/inactive).
- `tags` (List of String) Tags.
